blocks.zh: Chapter 3c: Process Equipment (3.2.7–3.2.9) / 製程設備（中下）
blocks.en: Chapter 3c: Process Equipment (3.2.7–3.2.9)

blocks.zh: Learning Objectives / 學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.en: Understand the principles, process factors, and equipment types for terminal sterilization (moist heat, irradiation)

blocks.zh: Distinguish overkill versus adjunct sterilization processes and their impact on facility design / 區分過度殺滅與輔助滅菌製程及其對設施設計的影響
blocks.en: Distinguish overkill versus adjunct sterilization processes and their impact on facility design

blocks.zh: Describe the regulatory basis and methods for visual inspection (manual, semi-automated, fully automated) / 說明目視檢查的法規基礎及各類方法（手動、半自動、全自動）
blocks.en: Describe the regulatory basis and methods for visual inspection (manual, semi-automated, fully automated)

blocks.zh: Explain the Knapp methodology and operator qualification requirements for inspection processes / 解釋 Knapp 方法學及檢查人員資格要求
blocks.en: Explain the Knapp methodology and operator qualification requirements for inspection processes

blocks.zh: Identify facility design considerations for inspection equipment, secondary packaging, and serialization / 確認檢查設備、二次包裝及序列化的設施設計考量
blocks.en: Identify facility design considerations for inspection equipment, secondary packaging, and serialization

blocks.zh: 3.2.7 Terminal Sterilization / 最終滅菌
blocks.en: 3.2.7 Terminal Sterilization

blocks.zh: 教學解說 — 繁體中文
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: 最終滅菌概述
blocks.en: Terminal Sterilization Overview

blocks.zh: 最終滅菌（Terminal Sterilization）是將產品在已完成充填與密封的最終包裝狀態下進行滅菌的製程。常用方法包括濕熱（蒸汽滅菌鍋）、輻射照射及其他適當方法。
blocks.en: Terminal sterilization is the process of sterilizing a product in its final container after filling and sealing. Common methods include moist heat (steam autoclave), irradiation, and other suitable methods.

blocks.zh: 核心原則：最終滅菌優先
blocks.en: Core Principle: Terminal Sterilization First

blocks.zh: 國際法規共識：只有當藥品配方無法承受最終滅菌條件（如蛋白質藥物熱不穩定）時，才應採用無菌製程（Aseptic Processing）。這反映了「能最終滅菌就不該用無菌製程」的基本邏輯。
blocks.en: International regulatory consensus: aseptic processing should be used only when the drug formulation cannot withstand terminal sterilization conditions (for example, heat-labile protein drugs). This reflects the basic logic that if a product can be terminally sterilized, it should not be aseptically processed.

blocks.zh: F0 值與滅菌策略
blocks.en: F0 Value and Sterilization Strategy

blocks.zh: F0 值代表在 121°C 下的等效滅菌時間：
blocks.en: The F0 value represents the equivalent sterilization time at 121°C:

blocks.zh: 過度殺滅（Overkill）：F0 ≥ 15 — 不需了解產品中的生物負荷，純靠高 F0 保證滅菌
blocks.en: Overkill: F0 ≥ 15 — no knowledge of the product bioburden is required; sterility is assured by a high F0 alone

blocks.zh: 輔助製程（Adjunct）：F0 ≥ 8 — 適用於不耐高溫產品，但需搭配嚴格的滅菌前生物負荷監控
blocks.en: Adjunct process: F0 ≥ 8 — suitable for heat-sensitive products, but requires strict pre-sterilization bioburden monitoring

blocks.zh: 兩者目標相同：達到 PNSU ≥ 10-6（每一百萬單位中不超過一個非無菌單位）。
blocks.en: Both approaches share the same goal: PNSU ≥ 10-6 (no more than one non-sterile unit per million units).

blocks.zh: 比喻：全熟牛排 vs. 三分熟牛排
blocks.en: Analogy: Well-Done vs. Medium-Rare Steak

blocks.zh: Overkill 像全熟牛排 — 不管肉的品質如何，高溫長時間一定熟透。Adjunct 像三分熟牛排 — 必須確認肉源品質優良（低生物負荷），才能用較短的加熱時間達到安全。
blocks.en: Overkill is like a well-done steak: whatever the quality of the meat, long high-temperature cooking will cook it through. Adjunct is like a medium-rare steak: you must be sure the meat source is of excellent quality (low bioburden) before a shorter cooking time can be considered safe.

blocks.zh: 設計關鍵：D 值與 F0 分佈
blocks.en: Key Design Point: D-Value and F0 Distribution

blocks.zh: 產品溶液可能「保護」微生物（如高黏度或高蛋白含量），導致需要更高的 F0。此外，滅菌鍋中不同位置的 F0 會有差異 — 加熱與冷卻階段都會累積 F0，但速率因位置而異。製程設計必須確保「最冷點」也達到要求。
blocks.en: The product solution may "protect" microorganisms (for example, high viscosity or high protein content), requiring a higher F0. In addition, F0 differs between locations in the autoclave: F0 accumulates during both the heating and cooling phases, but at rates that vary by location. The process design must ensure that the "cold spot" also achieves the required F0.

blocks.zh: 設施設計影響
blocks.en: Impact on Facility Design

blocks.zh: 最終滅菌對設施佈局有深遠影響，不僅是放一台滅菌鍋那麼簡單。
blocks.en: Terminal sterilization has a far-reaching impact on facility layout; it is much more than just placing an autoclave.

blocks.zh: 關鍵設施考量
blocks.en: Key Facility Considerations

blocks.zh: 非無菌/無菌物料隔離：使用貫穿式（pass-through）滅菌鍋，物料從非無菌側進、無菌側出，確保清潔區隔
blocks.en: Non-sterile/sterile material segregation: Use pass-through autoclaves, with material entering from the non-sterile side and exiting on the sterile side, to maintain clean separation

blocks.zh: 專用托盤與回流：滅菌用托盤需回收到加工區重複使用，形成設備逆向物流
blocks.en: Dedicated trays and return flow: Sterilization trays must be returned to the processing area for reuse, creating a reverse equipment flow

blocks.zh: 注射器特殊處理：滅菌時需倒置以避免冷凝水累積在針筒內
blocks.en: Special handling of syringes: Syringes must be inverted during sterilization to prevent condensate from accumulating inside the barrel

blocks.zh: 乾燥與暫存空間：滅菌後的產品需要排水和乾燥區，HVAC 系統需處理蒸汽帶來的顯熱與潛熱負載
blocks.en: Drying and holding space: Product needs a draining and drying area after sterilization, and the HVAC system must handle the sensible and latent heat loads from steam

blocks.zh: 公用設施負荷：大規模滅菌操作的蒸汽、冷卻水、壓縮空氣需求極為可觀
blocks.en: Utility loads: Large-scale sterilization operations demand substantial steam, cooling water, and compressed air

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務觀點
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Perspective

blocks.zh: 對代工廠而言，最終滅菌產品的設施需求遠大於純無菌充填線。需要額外的暫存區、專用托盤庫存、乾燥間及大容量公用設施。在產能規劃時，滅菌鍋的周轉時間（含裝載、滅菌、冷卻、卸載）往往是產線瓶頸。
blocks.en: For a contract manufacturer, the facility requirements for terminally sterilized products are far greater than for a purely aseptic filling line. Additional holding areas, a dedicated tray inventory, drying rooms, and high-capacity utilities are needed. In capacity planning, autoclave turnaround time (loading, sterilization, cooling, unloading) is often the line bottleneck.

blocks.zh: 空氣加壓與容器完整性
blocks.en: Air Ballasting and Container Integrity

blocks.zh: 液體充填容器在高溫滅菌時，內部壓力會隨溫度升高而增加。如果滅菌鍋腔體壓力低於容器內壓，容器可能膨脹破裂或密封失效。因此使用空氣加壓（Air Ballasting）來平衡壓差。
blocks.en: During high-temperature sterilization, the internal pressure of liquid-filled containers rises with temperature. If the autoclave chamber pressure is lower than the container internal pressure, containers may bulge, burst, or lose seal integrity. Air ballasting is therefore used to balance the pressure difference.

blocks.zh: 比喻：蒸爐 vs. 水浴鍋
blocks.en: Analogy: Steamer vs. Water Bath

blocks.zh: 空氣蒸汽混合型像蒸爐 — 蒸汽直接包圍產品，適合小東西但大物件受熱不均。過熱水淋浴型像水浴鍋 — 水的熱傳導效率高，適合大容量產品，但卸載後會比較濕。
blocks.en: An air-steam mix unit is like a steamer: steam surrounds the product directly, which suits small items but heats large items unevenly. A superheated water shower unit is like a water bath: water transfers heat efficiently and suits large-volume products, but the load is wetter after unloading.

blocks.zh: 3.2.8 Inspection / 檢查
blocks.en: 3.2.8 Inspection

blocks.zh: 檢查概述
blocks.en: Inspection Overview

blocks.zh: 所有供人體注射的產品都必須通過目視檢查（Visual Inspection），以確保無微粒污染（Particulate Matter）且容器密封完整。USP <790> 是目視檢查的核心法規依據。
blocks.en: All products intended for human injection must pass visual inspection to ensure they are free of particulate matter and that container closure is intact. USP <790> is the core regulatory basis for visual inspection.

blocks.zh: 常見檢查項目
blocks.en: Common Inspection Attributes

blocks.zh: 異物/微粒：溶液中的外來物質
blocks.en: Foreign matter/particulates: extraneous substances in the solution

blocks.zh: 充填量：確認符合標示裝量
blocks.en: Fill volume: confirming conformance to the labeled volume

blocks.zh: 容器完整性：安瓿密封、BFS 容器完整
blocks.en: Container integrity: ampoule seal, BFS container integrity

blocks.zh: 瓶蓋/壓蓋：膠塞存在性、顏色、壓蓋品質
blocks.en: Cap/crimp: presence and color of the stopper, crimp quality

blocks.zh: 安瓿封口黑點：熔封不良的指標
blocks.en: Black spots at the ampoule seal: an indicator of a poor fusion seal

blocks.zh: 凍乾餅外觀：是否有塌餅（meltback）
blocks.en: Lyophilized cake appearance: whether there is collapse (meltback)

blocks.zh: 檢查策略選擇
blocks.en: Choosing an Inspection Strategy

blocks.zh: 檢查可以在不同階段、以不同方式實施：
blocks.en: Inspection can be implemented at different stages and in different ways:

blocks.zh: 製程中抽樣：統計取樣（成本低但覆蓋率有限）
blocks.en: In-process sampling: statistical sampling (low cost but limited coverage)

blocks.zh: 100% 線上檢查：即時全檢但影響產線效率
blocks.en: 100% in-line inspection: real-time full inspection, but it reduces line efficiency

blocks.zh: 成品 100% 全檢：離線全檢，需額外空間和人力
blocks.en: 100% inspection of finished product: off-line full inspection, requiring additional space and personnel

blocks.zh: 成品 AQL 抽樣：依可接受品質限度抽樣
blocks.en: AQL sampling of finished product: sampling according to the acceptable quality limit

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務觀點：檢查是產能瓶頸
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Perspective: Inspection Is a Capacity Bottleneck

blocks.zh: 在代工廠中，檢查往往是整條產線最大的瓶頸。充填機可能每分鐘產出 300-600 瓶，但手動檢查只能處理數十瓶/分鐘。自動化檢查設備的投資報酬率在高產量產品上非常顯著，但對多品項小批量的 CDMO 而言，設備轉換（changeover）時間也是關鍵考量。
blocks.en: At a contract manufacturer, inspection is often the biggest bottleneck on the entire line. A filling machine may output 300-600 vials per minute, while manual inspection can handle only a few dozen vials per minute. The return on investment for automated inspection equipment is very significant for high-volume products, but for a CDMO with many products in small batches, equipment changeover time is also a key consideration.

blocks.zh: 設計因素與成本效益
blocks.en: Design Factors and Cost-Effectiveness

blocks.zh: 線上 vs. 離線檢查的取捨
blocks.en: Trade-offs Between In-line and Off-line Inspection

blocks.zh: 線上（In-line）：減少物料搬運，但降低產線整體效率（OEE）
blocks.en: In-line: reduces material handling, but lowers overall line efficiency (OEE)

blocks.zh: 離線（Decoupled）：不影響產線速度，但需要暫存空間（WIP）和額外搬運人力
blocks.en: Off-line (decoupled): does not affect line speed, but requires holding space (WIP) and additional handling personnel

blocks.zh: 選擇取決於產品價值、批量大小及設施空間限制。
blocks.en: The choice depends on product value, batch size, and facility space constraints.

blocks.zh: PAT（製程分析技術）可以即時監控某些屬性（如充填重量），減少或消除對這些項目的離線檢查需求。
blocks.en: PAT (process analytical technology) can monitor certain attributes in real time (such as fill weight), reducing or eliminating the need for off-line inspection of those attributes.

blocks.zh: 新興檢查技術
blocks.en: Emerging Inspection Technologies

blocks.zh: X 射線分析：檢測凍乾餅中的不可見微粒
blocks.en: X-ray analysis: detects invisible particles in lyophilized cakes

blocks.zh: 近紅外光（NIR）：非破壞性測量凍乾餅水分含量
blocks.en: Near-infrared (NIR): non-destructive measurement of moisture content in lyophilized cakes

blocks.zh: 頂空分析（HSA）：確認真空或惰性氣體密封的容器密封完整性（CCI）
blocks.en: Headspace analysis (HSA): confirms container closure integrity (CCI) of containers sealed under vacuum or inert gas

blocks.zh: 這些技術需逐案評估是否納入檢查流程。
blocks.en: These technologies should be evaluated case by case for inclusion in the inspection process.

blocks.zh: 比喻：氣泡 vs. 微粒
blocks.en: Analogy: Bubbles vs. Particles

blocks.zh: 某些液體產品在充填後會產生氣泡，這些氣泡在自動檢查時會被誤判為微粒。就像剛倒好的汽水 — 需要等氣泡消散（relaxation time）或先旋轉（pre-spin）讓氣泡浮出，才能準確檢測真正的異物。
blocks.en: Some liquid products generate bubbles after filling, and automated inspection can misread these bubbles as particles. It is like a freshly poured soda: you need to wait for the bubbles to dissipate (relaxation time) or spin the container first (pre-spin) so the bubbles rise out, before real foreign matter can be detected accurately.

blocks.zh: 3.2.8.1 Visual Inspection / 目視檢查
blocks.en: 3.2.8.1 Visual Inspection

blocks.zh: 目視檢查方法
blocks.en: Visual Inspection Methods

blocks.zh: 許多檢查標準本質上是視覺性的 — 如「基本上無可見微粒」或凍乾餅外觀。因此建立人工檢查基線（Manual Inspection Baseline）和挑戰組（Challenge Sets）極為重要。
blocks.en: Many inspection criteria are inherently visual, such as "essentially free of visible particulates" or lyophilized cake appearance. It is therefore extremely important to establish a manual inspection baseline and challenge sets.

blocks.zh: 缺陷庫（Defect Library）
blocks.en: Defect Library

blocks.zh: 缺陷庫是檢查系統的基礎設施：
blocks.en: The defect library is the foundation of the inspection system:

blocks.zh: 包含實際缺陷樣品、照片/影片及書面描述
blocks.en: Contains actual defect samples, photographs/videos, and written descriptions

blocks.zh: 重點收集關鍵缺陷（Critical Defects）的範例
blocks.en: Focuses on collecting examples of critical defects

blocks.zh: 樣品會因反覆操作而劣化，需持續更新 — 尤其凍乾產品的缺陷樣品更易變質
blocks.en: Samples deteriorate through repeated handling and must be continually refreshed; defect samples of lyophilized products in particular degrade more easily

blocks.zh: 重點：RZE 與假拒絕率的平衡
blocks.en: Key Point: Balancing RZE and False Reject Rate

blocks.zh: 檢查系統需同時滿足兩個目標：(1) 足夠高的 RZE 確保真正缺陷品被剔除；(2) 足夠低的假拒絕率避免浪費合格品。可透過二次檢查（reinspection of 1x rejects）策略來降低假拒絕率，前提是合併後的 RZE 仍然達標。
blocks.en: The inspection system must meet two objectives at once: (1) a sufficiently high RZE to ensure that truly defective units are rejected; and (2) a sufficiently low false reject rate to avoid wasting acceptable product. The false reject rate can be reduced through a reinspection strategy (reinspection of 1x rejects), provided the combined RZE still meets the target.

blocks.zh: Knapp 方法學：容器分類
blocks.en: Knapp Methodology: Container Classification

blocks.zh: 拒絕區效率（RZE）衡量的是：必須被剔除的缺陷容器，實際被成功剔除的比例。
blocks.en: Reject zone efficiency (RZE) measures the proportion of defective containers that must be rejected that are actually rejected successfully.

blocks.zh: 3.2.8.2 Operator Qualification / 操作人員資格
blocks.en: 3.2.8.2 Operator Qualification

blocks.zh: 檢查員資格與訓練
blocks.en: Inspector Qualification and Training

blocks.zh: 檢查員資格要求
blocks.en: Inspector Qualification Requirements

blocks.zh: 初始資格：使用已知缺陷比例的測試組進行多次成功檢查
blocks.en: Initial qualification: multiple successful inspections using a test set with a known proportion of defects

blocks.zh: 年度再確認：至少每年一次重新驗證
blocks.en: Annual requalification: revalidation at least once a year

blocks.zh: 視力測試：近視力敏銳度 + 色彩辨識能力（初始及定期）
blocks.en: Vision testing: near-vision acuity plus color discrimination (initially and periodically)

blocks.zh: 合格班次時間：建立每人每日可執行檢查的最長時間
blocks.en: Qualified shift time: establish the maximum time each person may perform inspection per day

blocks.zh: 疲勞管理
blocks.en: Fatigue Management

blocks.zh: 目視檢查極度依賴眼力，操作員疲勞是品質風險的主要來源。ISPE 建議：
blocks.en: Visual inspection depends heavily on eyesight, and operator fatigue is a major source of quality risk. ISPE recommends:

blocks.zh: 每小時強制休息一次
blocks.en: Mandatory break every hour

blocks.zh: 優化環境照明、背景噪音及人體工學
blocks.en: Optimize lighting, background noise, and ergonomics

blocks.zh: 建立輪班機制，避免長時間連續檢查
blocks.en: Establish a rotation scheme to avoid long continuous inspection periods

blocks.zh: 比喻：航空管制員的輪班制度
blocks.en: Analogy: Air Traffic Controller Shift Schedules

blocks.zh: 目視檢查員的疲勞管理類似航空管制員 — 高度專注的工作不能連續太久。管制員每工作 1.5-2 小時就必須休息，目視檢查員同理。忽視疲勞管理等於接受檢查品質隨時間下降的風險。
blocks.en: Fatigue management for visual inspectors is similar to that for air traffic controllers: highly concentrated work cannot continue for too long. Controllers must rest after every 1.5-2 hours of work, and the same applies to visual inspectors. Neglecting fatigue management means accepting the risk that inspection quality declines over time.

blocks.zh: 3.2.8.3 Visual Inspection Methods and Equipment / 目視檢查方法與設備
blocks.en: 3.2.8.3 Visual Inspection Methods and Equipment

blocks.zh: 手動目視檢查 (MVI)
blocks.en: Manual Visual Inspection (MVI)

blocks.zh: MVI 是最基礎的檢查方式：操作員在受控條件下逐瓶檢視。關鍵製程參數（CPP）包括光源波長/強度、背景對比、檢查速率及容器操作方式。
blocks.en: MVI is the most basic inspection method: operators examine containers one by one under controlled conditions. Critical process parameters (CPPs) include light source wavelength/intensity, background contrast, inspection rate, and container handling method.

blocks.zh: MVI 限制
blocks.en: MVI Limitations

blocks.zh: 產出速度最低，通常離線進行
blocks.en: Lowest throughput, usually performed off-line

blocks.zh: 放大鏡可用但不建議例行使用 — 增加眼睛疲勞且不一定提升檢出率
blocks.en: Magnifiers can be used but are not recommended for routine use; they increase eye fatigue and do not necessarily improve detection

blocks.zh: 仍是異常調查和自動設備高拒絕率時的必要能力
blocks.en: Remains a necessary capability for investigating anomalies and when automated equipment has a high reject rate

blocks.zh: 半自動檢查機
blocks.en: Semi-Automated Inspection Machines

blocks.zh: 機器負責傳送與旋轉產品，操作員負責判斷。可調整光源、產品角度、鏡面角度、背景及旋轉速度來強化缺陷可見性。
blocks.en: The machine conveys and spins the product, and the operator makes the judgment. The light source, product angle, mirror angle, background, and spin speed can be adjusted to enhance defect visibility.

blocks.zh: 比喻：壽司迴轉台 + 品管員
blocks.en: Analogy: Sushi Conveyor Belt + QC Inspector

blocks.zh: 半自動檢查機就像壽司迴轉台 — 產品自動旋轉送到眼前，檢查員只需專心看（不用拿取和放回），大幅提升效率。但設計階段常高估實際產出速率，應以「最差情況產出率」進行產能分析。
blocks.en: A semi-automated inspection machine is like a sushi conveyor belt: product is spun and delivered in front of the inspector, who only needs to focus on looking (no picking up and putting back), greatly improving efficiency. However, the actual throughput is often overestimated at the design stage, so capacity analysis should use the "worst-case throughput."

blocks.zh: 全自動檢查機
blocks.en: Fully Automated Inspection Machines

blocks.zh: 全自動系統使用自動化物料傳輸搭配一個或多個相機站及其他檢測儀器（如 X 射線、雷射頂空分析）。
blocks.en: Fully automated systems use automated material transport together with one or more camera stations and other detection instruments (such as X-ray or laser headspace analysis).

blocks.zh: 自動化檢查能力一覽
blocks.en: Overview of Automated Inspection Capabilities

blocks.zh: 溶液中微粒
blocks.en: Particulates in solution

blocks.zh: 充填液位
blocks.en: Fill level

blocks.zh: 翻蓋存在性與顏色
blocks.en: Flip-off cap presence and color

blocks.zh: 安瓿環帶顏色
blocks.en: Ampoule color ring

blocks.zh: 壓蓋品質（無凹痕/皺褶）
blocks.en: Crimp quality (no dents/wrinkles)

blocks.zh: 玻璃裂紋（瓶尖、頸、肩、壁、底）
blocks.en: Glass cracks (vial tip, neck, shoulder, wall, bottom)

blocks.zh: 柱塞位置（注射器/卡匣）
blocks.en: Plunger position (syringes/cartridges)

blocks.zh: 針頭護套存在性
blocks.en: Needle shield presence

blocks.zh: 凍乾餅外觀
blocks.en: Lyophilized cake appearance

blocks.zh: 影像庫的價值
blocks.en: Value of the Image Library

blocks.zh: 現代自動檢查機可擷取並儲存大量影像，形成「影像庫」。用途包括：
blocks.en: Modern automated inspection machines can capture and store large numbers of images, forming an "image library." Uses include:

blocks.zh: 調查異常拒絕率時回溯分析
blocks.en: Retrospective analysis when investigating abnormal reject rates

blocks.zh: 設備調機時使用影像進行「虛擬檢查」，避免反覆操作實體樣品導致劣化
blocks.en: Using images for "virtual inspection" during machine tuning, avoiding the deterioration of physical samples through repeated handling

blocks.zh: 優化機器參數而不消耗挑戰組樣品
blocks.en: Optimizing machine parameters without consuming challenge set samples

blocks.zh: 思考題：選擇檢查策略
blocks.en: Discussion Question: Choosing an Inspection Strategy

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 同時生產高價值生物製劑（年產 10 批，每批 5,000 瓶）和低價值小分子注射劑（年產 50 批，每批 50,000 瓶）。
blocks.en: A CDMO produces both a high-value biologic (10 batches per year, 5,000 vials per batch) and a low-value small-molecule injectable (50 batches per year, 50,000 vials per batch).

blocks.zh: 高價值產品應採用何種檢查策略？為什麼？
blocks.en: What inspection strategy should be adopted for the high-value product, and why?

blocks.zh: 低價值高產量產品呢？
blocks.en: What about the low-value, high-volume product?

blocks.zh: 如何在共用設施中平衡兩者的檢查需求？
blocks.en: How can the inspection needs of the two be balanced in a shared facility?

blocks.zh: 設施設計提醒
blocks.en: Facility Design Reminder

blocks.zh: 自動檢查設備可能有特殊設施需求：X 射線系統需要屏蔽、光學系統需要環境光控制。這些需求應在設施設計階段就納入考量，避免事後改裝的高成本。
blocks.en: Automated inspection equipment may have special facility requirements: X-ray systems require shielding, and optical systems require ambient light control. These requirements should be considered at the facility design stage to avoid the high cost of later retrofitting.

blocks.zh: 3.2.9 Secondary Packaging / 二次包裝
blocks.en: 3.2.9 Secondary Packaging

blocks.zh: 二次包裝
blocks.en: Secondary Packaging

blocks.zh: 無菌產品的二次包裝原則與一般產品相同，包括標示（Labeling）、裝盒、裝箱等。ISPE 另有專門的包裝、標示及倉儲設施指南可參考。
blocks.en: The principles of secondary packaging for sterile products are the same as for general products, including labeling, cartoning, and case packing. ISPE also has dedicated guidance on packaging, labeling, and warehousing facilities that can be consulted.

blocks.zh: 序列化（Serialization）趨勢
blocks.en: Serialization Trends

blocks.zh: 全球多個法規市場正在推動或已實施產品序列化要求：
blocks.en: Many regulatory markets worldwide are promoting or have already implemented product serialization requirements:

blocks.zh: 目的：防偽 — 每個單位產品都有唯一識別碼
blocks.en: Purpose: anti-counterfeiting; every product unit carries a unique identifier

blocks.zh: 技術：在包裝過程中貼附唯一編碼（如 2D barcode），可在整個配送鏈中查驗
blocks.en: Technology: a unique code (such as a 2D barcode) is applied during packaging and can be verified throughout the distribution chain

blocks.zh: 設施影響：需要在包裝線上預留空間和介面，供序列化設備（印碼機、相機驗證系統、資料管理系統）使用
blocks.en: Facility impact: space and interfaces must be reserved on the packaging line for serialization equipment (coders, camera verification systems, data management systems)

blocks.zh: 設計前瞻性
blocks.en: Design Foresight

blocks.zh: 即使目前市場尚未強制要求序列化，新建或改建包裝線時應預留空間和公用設施介面，以便未來加裝序列化設備。改裝成本遠高於預留空間的成本。
blocks.en: Even if the market does not currently mandate serialization, when building or modifying a packaging line, space and utility interfaces should be reserved so that serialization equipment can be added in the future. The cost of retrofitting is far higher than the cost of reserving space.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：序列化的挑戰
blocks.en: CDMO Practice: Serialization Challenges

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，序列化帶來額外複雜度：不同客戶可能需要不同的序列化格式和標準（EU FMD、US DSCSA、中國追溯碼等）。包裝線需要靈活的軟體配置能力和快速切換能力。這是選擇包裝設備供應商時的關鍵評估項目。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, serialization adds complexity: different customers may require different serialization formats and standards (EU FMD, US DSCSA, China traceability codes, and so on). Packaging lines need flexible software configuration and fast changeover capability. This is a key evaluation item when selecting packaging equipment suppliers.

blocks.zh: Section Summary / 本節摘要
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: Terminal Sterilization (3.2.7) / 最終滅菌： Products sealed in final packaging are sterilized via moist heat or irradiation. Overkill (F0 ≥ 15) and adjunct (F0 ≥ 8) processes both target PNSU ≥ 10-6. Facility design must address non-sterile/sterile segregation, specialized trays, drying areas, and significant utility loads. / 最終包裝產品透過濕熱或輻射滅菌。過度殺滅與輔助製程目標相同。設施需考量物料隔離、專用托盤、乾燥區及大量公用設施需求。
blocks.en: Terminal Sterilization (3.2.7): Products sealed in final packaging are sterilized via moist heat or irradiation. Overkill (F0 ≥ 15) and adjunct (F0 ≥ 8) processes both target PNSU ≥ 10-6. Facility design must address non-sterile/sterile segregation, specialized trays, drying areas, and significant utility loads.

blocks.zh: Autoclave Types / 滅菌鍋類型： Air steam mix units (small volumes, drier load) vs. superheated water shower units (large volumes, faster heating/cooling, better uniformity). Air ballasting protects container integrity during sterilization. / 空氣蒸汽混合型（小容量、較乾）vs. 過熱水淋浴型（大容量、加熱冷卻快、均勻性佳）。空氣加壓保護容器完整性。
blocks.en: Autoclave Types: Air steam mix units (small volumes, drier load) vs. superheated water shower units (large volumes, faster heating/cooling, better uniformity). Air ballasting protects container integrity during sterilization.

blocks.zh: Inspection (3.2.8) / 檢查： USP <790> requires visual inspection of all parenteral units. The Knapp methodology (RZE, PR zones) provides a scientific framework for qualifying both manual and automated inspection. Operator qualification, fatigue management, and defect libraries are essential. / USP <790> 要求所有注射劑目視檢查。Knapp 方法提供科學化的資格確認框架。操作員資格、疲勞管理與缺陷庫不可或缺。
blocks.en: Inspection (3.2.8): USP <790> requires visual inspection of all parenteral units. The Knapp methodology (RZE, PR zones) provides a scientific framework for qualifying both manual and automated inspection. Operator qualification, fatigue management, and defect libraries are essential.

blocks.zh: Inspection Methods (3.2.8.3) / 檢查方法： MVI (lowest throughput, off-line), semi-automatic (operator + machine, higher throughput), and fully automatic (camera-based, highest throughput, real-time image analysis). Emerging technologies include X-ray, NIR, and HSA. / MVI（最低產出、離線）、半自動（操作員+機器）、全自動（相機、最高產出、即時影像分析）。新興技術包括 X 射線、NIR 及頂空分析。
blocks.en: Inspection Methods (3.2.8.3): MVI (lowest throughput, off-line), semi-automatic (operator + machine, higher throughput), and fully automatic (camera-based, highest throughput, real-time image analysis). Emerging technologies include X-ray, NIR, and HSA.

blocks.zh: Secondary Packaging (3.2.9) / 二次包裝： Same principles as non-sterile products. Product serialization for anti-counterfeiting is an emerging requirement; line design should accommodate future serialization equipment. / 原則同非無菌產品。序列化防偽是新興要求，產線設計應預留未來設備空間。
blocks.en: Secondary Packaging (3.2.9): Same principles as non-sterile products. Product serialization for anti-counterfeiting is an emerging requirement; line design should accommodate future serialization equipment.
